title: ONSure owns common verification knowledge
text: ONSure is the source of truth for shared verification knowledge, target profiles, repeated-loop harness evidence, cause-aware findings, RAG material, and remediation memory. ORUDA remains the target implementation repository for ODocument, OReport, ODesign, and OUI. This separation prevents the target program from defining its own verification criteria.

title: ORUDA report chain stage order
text: The ORUDA report-generation chain is ODocument Raw, ODocument Claim, OReport PageSpec, ODesign Formal Procedure, OUI Lossless Canonical Scene, Canvas Render Binding, and OTester/OAudit Final Gates. Every stage after the first must include the parent hash of the previous stage, and every stage body must be hashed from the exact canonical body consumed downstream.

title: ODocument source evidence contract
text: ODocument must output raw bytes hash, claim body, claim source hash, claim body hash, and parent hash from raw to claim. Missing claim source_hash, claim body drift after hashing, or missing raw-to-claim parent binding must block completion.

title: OReport PageSpec contract
text: OReport must convert claims into PageSpec while preserving page intent, information priority, geometry contract, and parent hash from claim. It must not generate arbitrary pages that lose purpose, evidence basis, or layout contract required by ODesign and OUI.

title: ODesign formal procedure contract
text: ODesign must follow the ordered formal procedure: page intent, information priority, concept croquis, layout candidate comparison, detailed croquis, asset selection, geometry contract, and visual quality gate. Missing or reordered procedure receipts must block downstream OUI generation.

title: OUI lossless scene contract
text: OUI must preserve a lossless canonical scene with objects, field manifest, coordinates, size, font, color, asset references, layer order, and accessibility metadata when applicable. Rendering must be bound to canonical run hash, scene hash, field manifest hash, and render hash.

title: Final completion gate
text: Final completion is forbidden unless OTester and OAudit are both PASS and receipt-bound. PENDING, NOT_RUN, missing, or invalid receipt hashes must block completion.

title: PROGRAM_ROUTE_MISSING cause
text: PROGRAM_ROUTE_MISSING means a target program is registered but its runtime, contract, or test route is missing or non-standard. The remediation is to add the missing route to the target profile and require it during intake before verification can pass.

title: STAGE_PARENT_HASH_MISSING cause
text: STAGE_PARENT_HASH_MISSING means a stage can consume fabricated or regenerated input because parent binding is missing or stale. The remediation is to bind each stage input to the previous stage output hash and reject drift before execution.

title: STAGE_BODY_DRIFT cause
text: STAGE_BODY_DRIFT means a stage body changed after hash recording, enabling fixture replay or middle-output substitution. The remediation is to hash the exact canonical body consumed by the next stage and verify it at the boundary.

title: REQUIRED_OUTPUT_FIELD_MISSING cause
text: REQUIRED_OUTPUT_FIELD_MISSING means a target program dropped fields required for downstream correctness or auditability. The remediation is to promote the missing field set into the program contract and bind it to downstream receipts.

title: FORMAL_PROCEDURE_MISSING cause
text: FORMAL_PROCEDURE_MISSING means a target program produced output without approved procedural receipts. The remediation is to require configured procedure steps in order, with each step parent-bound to the previous receipt.

title: RENDER_OR_OUTPUT_BINDING_MISSING cause
text: RENDER_OR_OUTPUT_BINDING_MISSING means the final output hash is not bound to the full canonical intermediate representation. The remediation is to hash the full canonical representation and required field manifest into the final output receipt.

title: FINAL_GATE_NOT_PASS cause
text: FINAL_GATE_NOT_PASS means final completion can be claimed while an independent verifier, audit gate, or required receipt is pending. The remediation is to block final completion unless every configured final gate is PASS and receipt-bound.

title: Repeated loop stability rule
text: ONSure should run target verification two or three times before promoting findings into RAG or memory. Stable promotion requires the same decision, cause code sequence, remediation targets, memory kinds, and evidence projection hash across loops. Unstable loop results are ONSure defects.

title: RAG inclusion and exclusion policy
text: RAG should include stable contracts, stable failure classes, remediation patterns, final gate rules, repeated-loop harness rules, and verifiable report quality rules. It should exclude temporary PR status, branch names unless required as evidence, conversational status updates, unverified suggestions, and one-off implementation details.
